# TraceMint

> TraceMint finds unlicensed copies of registered artwork online, has GenLayer
> validators judge each copy against the creator's own licence terms, and lets the
> site owner settle by paying that licence on chain. The creator keeps 97% of the fee.

TraceMint runs on GenLayer Studio Next (chain 61997). Every claim, verdict, licence
and payout is a transaction that anyone can read in the block explorer.

## How it works

1. A creator registers a work: the image, a portfolio URL that proves the wallet is
   theirs, licence terms in plain words, a base price, and the pages to watch.
2. An agent fetches those pages and compares any image it finds with the registered work.
3. For each candidate a GenLayer leader validator reads the page and proposes a verdict.
   Other validators repeat the work and vote. Only an agreed verdict is recorded.
4. An agreed unlicensed copy becomes a notice with a fee, calculated from the base price,
   how the copy is used and how prominent it is.
5. The site owner pays the fee and receives an on-chain licence, or disputes it with a URL
   that shows permission. A dispute is judged the same way.

## What it costs

Registering, watching and scanning are free beyond network fees. TraceMint takes 3% of a
licence fee it collects; the creator receives 97% and withdraws directly from the contract.

## Limits worth stating

A notice is an automated finding reached by validator consensus, not legal advice, and a
licence is a commercial settlement under terms the creator published. Validators can fail to
agree, in which case nothing is recorded and the agent tries again on its next run.
